# Protected Bcc filtering keeps outer headers and recipient fields separate

MimePart.getHeaderString(true) copies the header map and removes its literal bcc and resent-bcc entries. MimeMessage first writes the default header serialization to the outer stream, then passes the filtered serialization to crypto encapsulation. The secure composer stores and uses that prepared text in protected MIME input, while the separate recipient string still includes compFields.bcc. These are distinct contracts. The inspected setHeader method does not normalize arbitrary supplied key casing, and this static evidence does not prove delivery or cryptographic validity.

Scope: Thunderbird MIME composition and OpenPGP protected headers.
